Third-party libraries bundled with the HeatGuard frontend (unmodified copies from cdnjs):
- Chart.js 4.4.1  - MIT License - https://www.chartjs.org/ (https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/blob/master/LICENSE.md)
- Leaflet 1.9.4   - BSD 2-Clause License - https://leafletjs.com/ (https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/blob/main/LICENSE)
- India and neighbouring country outlines: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 countries, India point-of-view edition
  (ne_10m_admin_0_countries_ind.geojson, public domain, https://www.naturalearthdata.com/), simplified for size.
